state.goal: Complete original CanChat Position7 preserving private fields, source, permissions, evaluation, rollback and saved replay.
state.original_source: chat.ask by=members -> Run; requires can_use(actor,branch.parent) and current Profile/Allowance constraints; creates Run.request_value:TextRequest from admitted finalized ordered File[] and sends the original checked payload. Run read policies deliberately omit request_value. Returned Run exposes only original declared public fields.
state.actual_writer: Verified assembler/source/executable original call; State owns actual admitted root/child session, current owner/caller/guards, original declared field codec, complete topfield wire, surviving final net writes/versions, physical File observation and receiver checks. Assignment locators carry no authority. Child locators share only the private real root owner effects.
state.current_guard: State nominal assignment final guard first physically revalidates each captured File, then uses original current source row+complete ancestor policies and coherent SDK Identity at the same revision. It additionally requires a PUBLIC read grant for the assigned topfield. That extra field check refuses the intentionally hidden request_value even for its legitimate writer.
state.saved_disclosure: Separate current saved result/record field-grant and secret withholding checks remain mandatory. Assignment evidence never grants a read or exposes request_value.

alternatives.private_assignment: Remove ONLY the public field-grant inclusion requirement from the authentic execution ASSIGNMENT guard; retain nonnull current source row+ancestor projection, actual writer admission/source/effects/caller/final guards, complete typed/physical/receiver/revision/lifetime conjunction and all separate disclosure checks. No new DTO/API/profile.
alternatives.write_producer: Keep public field-read check until a separate explicit private-write producer is implemented and proven from genuine original source effect/owner/caller/session. This more explicit separation costs another producer; do not infer source from schema/locator shapes.
alternatives.keep_refusal: Keep source unchanged and refuse the hidden nominal assignment if current writer/source mechanism cannot justify it; identify the exact missing contract. Do not add a public read policy to expose private request contents.

controls: late membership/ancestor revocation and physical loss refuse before publication
public and saved result fields retain exact original grants and secret withholding
unknown declarations and existing200/20k/depth bounds unchanged

design.instructions: Choose the smallest complete safe behavior for the original CanChat writer: separate assignment from public field disclosure using the existing source/owner session, add a defining writer producer, or keep the refusal. Consider late revocation, physical Files, effect correspondence and saved privacy equally.
